purpose: Application service for asset reads, uploads, metadata changes, archiving, permanent delete, and bulk category assignment.
businessRules: Asset search/detail reads are KV-first with PostgreSQL fallback.
Asset search/detail responses carry versioned media URLs for originals and variants.
Admin asset workflows are limited to catalog-managed media and must not expose brand/system chrome as editable DAM records.
Asset search and mutation contracts carry categoryFamilyKey and categoryProductTypeKey so images can be managed at taxonomy-family and subcategory granularity.
Uploads store the original, create a DB record, generate variants, persist variant metadata, and mark the asset ready.
Image replacement preserves the existing asset key, locks the row, writes a new versioned original object key, regenerates variants/LQIP, bumps asset version, and returns S3-compatible URLs.
Metadata updates, archive/remove, permanent delete, and bulk assignment flows publish media table KV invalidation only after commit.
Permanent delete clears storefront media references before deleting the media asset row and cascade-owned variants.
Storefront home KV is refreshed after asset mutations because storefront media depends on media tables.
